notes: Prices in USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch) API tier. Tiered-price models record the base (lowest) tier with the higher tier in the model's note field. Retired models excluded; deprecated-but-available models included. Collected Wednesday 2026-10-14, 9 days after the previous file. The Monday 2026-10-12 snapshot was missed and is not backfilled: this file is dated by its actual collection day, so the gap from 2026-10-05 is 9 days, not 7, and any change below may have occurred on any day in that window. Tracked scope follows the set established on 2026-07-16 so week-over-week deltas stay meaningful. The set moves from 53 to 54 rows: three models arrived, two left, and no row was replaced. Of the 51 rows carried on input, output and cache-read price, 50 are unchanged on all three. The one carried price change is a cut: Claude Sonnet 5.5's cache read falls from $0.20 to $0.10 (-50%). The pricing page now lists Claude Sonnet 5.5 under the 0.05x cache-read multiplier alongside Claude Opus 5.5, where on 2026-10-05 it used the standard 0.1x; input, output and cache writes are unchanged. Claude Sonnet 5 stays at $0.20, so Sonnet 5.5 no longer matches Sonnet 5 on every line of the Anthropic table. Input and output price on all 51 carried rows are unchanged, a seventh consecutive collection with no input or output change on the carried set. The three arrivals: Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) at $0.10/$0.50 with cache read $0.01 and a 1M context window, for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; prompts over 100,000 tokens pay $0.50/$2.50 (cache read $0.05), and the page says a request's prompt length counts cache reads and writes, and that each request is priced on its own. The page now says Claude 4.6 and later models except Haiku 5.5 include the full 1M window at standard pricing. Against Claude Haiku 4.5 ($1.00/$5.00), the base tier is one tenth on input and output, and it enters at exactly gpt-6-luna's $0.10/$0.50. Claude Haiku 4.5 remains listed at unchanged prices. Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon), GA on 2026-10-13 per the Gemini API changelog, at $2.00/$10.00 with cache read $0.10 through 2026-11-30, doubling to $4.00/$20.00 (cache $0.20) on 2026-12-01; implicit caching only, no free tier, context window 1,048,576. It is the second Google introductory expiry in the set and falls a month before the two remaining Gemini Flash rows' 2026-12-31 expiry. Mistral Large 4 (mistral-large-4), listed first in Mistral's flagship table and recorded at the page's sale price of $0.68/$2.09 (cached input $0.07); the struck-through original price is $1.36/$4.18 (cached $0.14), and the page states no end date for the sale. Its model page returned 404 on collection day, so no context window is recorded. The two departures are Google deprecations of 2026-10-08, not retirements in the usual sense: gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.5-flash are no longer on the pricing page and no longer selectable in AI Studio, and the deprecations page says their endpoints are not shutting down but automatically route API requests to gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.6-flash respectively. The rows are removed because no price is listed for either id. Neither page states what a routed request is billed at. If it is billed at the target model's rate, a caller still sending gemini-3.5-flash moves from $1.50/$9.00 to $0.75/$3.75 without changing anything; a caller on gemini-3.7-flash sees no price difference. This is a model substitution under the old id, so capability as well as price may differ for those callers. Newly recorded, with no price effect: Mistral's pricing page carries a cached-input column at 0.1x base input, and the four carried Mistral rows now record it (mistral-large-3 $0.05, mistral-medium-3.5 $0.15, mistral-small-4 $0.015, codestral $0.03). Earlier snapshots left these fields null; whether the page carried the column before 2026-10-14 was not established, so null to value on these rows is not a price change. Also observed and outside the rows: OpenAI's pricing page adds an 'Ultrafast' tier beside Standard, Batch, Flex and Fast for gpt-6-astra ($60.00/$300.00) and gpt-6.1-sol ($12.00/$60.00), six times standard; OpenAI lists gpt-rosalind-research and gpt-rosalind-discovery ($5.00/$25.00, cached $0.50) under 'Life sciences models' with access limited to an approved trusted-access program, and gpt-rosalind-research billing beginning 2026-10-05, outside scope as restricted domain models; Google deprecated gemini-3.1-flash-image on 2026-10-06 in favour of gemini-nano-banana-2.1 (image models, excluded); Mistral no longer lists the GLM 5.2 resale or the free Leanstral 1.5 endpoint, neither of which was a row; xAI's pricing page describes Grok 4.7 Fast at 2x standard rates (1.5x long context), available only in Cursor and Grok Build and not on the public API, so it is not a row. Still observed and still out of the rows: Gemini Omni Flash and Gemini Omni Flash Preview (video models); Gemma 4 with no paid tier; Mistral's GLM 5.3 resale ($1.40/$4.40), excluded per the 2026-09-21 decision; Ministral 3 in three sizes (3B $0.10/$0.10, 8B $0.15/$0.15, 14B $0.20/$0.20); OpenAI gpt-5.6-cyber ($12.50/$75.00), gpt-5.2 and earlier; and Google's image, embedding, TTS, video, live and transcription models. No new Anthropic deprecation since 2026-09-30; claude-sonnet-4-5 remains deprecated with retirement on 2026-11-30. Carried statements unchanged this week: Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview use a newer tokenizer the page says produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, with the exact increase depending on content and workload shape — per-token prices are unchanged, so the eleven affected rows (claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-mythos-5, claude-mythos-5-1) cost more per unit of text than a per-token comparison against a 4.6-and-earlier row shows; DeepSeek still accepts the legacy ids deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp while serving both from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at Flash pricing, and peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) still apply Monday through Friday excluding Chinese public holidays; the three Gemini Flash rows at $0.75/$3.75 are now two (gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.6-flash) and still carry a 2026-12-31 introductory expiry that doubles them on 2027-01-01; Anthropic still states the Claude Sonnet 5 $2/$10 rate is standard and that the cancelled 2026-09-01 increase will not occur; and OpenAI still states gpt-5.6-sol's promotional pricing is available at least through 2026-11-21.
